userStories.title: Fix verifier.py - real on-chain balance x Nansen price verification
userStories.description:
Current state: verifier.py exists at businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/verifier.py. It calls Basescan tokenbalance API and gets a raw integer (e.g. 179087500000000000000 for 179.09 AERO with 18 decimals). It then compares that raw integer directly to position_usd (e.g. 60.0). This comparison is nonsense - it always passes because raw_balance > 0. The verifier logs nothing useful.

reconcile.py already has get_token_balance(w3, token_address, wallet_address) at line 64 which correctly handles decimals and returns token float units. It is at businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/reconcile.py.

scanner.py has _load_screener_cache() which fetches Nansen token-screener for current price_usd. The Telegram notify pattern is in exit_monitor.py: uses TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env vars. TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID is not set - use TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS instead (env var '374999219' is the correct chat id for Mr. V).

What to build: Rewrite verify_position() in verifier.py to:
1. Get on-chain token balance using the same web3 logic as reconcile.py get_token_balance() - import it: sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent)) then from reconcile import get_web3, get_token_balance
2. Get current price via POST to https://api.nansen.ai/api/v1/token-screener with json={'chains':['base'],'timeframe':'24h'} - use requests library - find matching token_address in response data list, extract price_usd
3. Compute current_usd = token_balance * price_usd
4. Compute discrepancy_pct = abs(current_usd - position_usd) / position_usd * 100
5. PASS if discrepancy_pct < 20% AND token_balance > 0
6. FAIL with alarm if: discrepancy_pct >= 20%, OR token_balance == 0, OR price_nansen <= stop_loss (within 3% of stop)
7. Log structured JSON to data/verifier_log.jsonl per position: {ts, symbol, address, token_balance_onchain, price_usd, current_usd, position_usd, discrepancy_pct, stop_loss, pct_above_stop, status, error}
8. On any FAIL: send Telegram message using requests.post to https://api.telegram.org/bot{TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage with chat_id from env var TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS
9. Read NANSEN_API_KEY and BASE_WALLET_ADDRESS (not BASE_WALLET) from env - load from ~/.openclaw/.env if not set
10. Exit 0 if all pass, exit 1 if any fail

Constraints:
- Do NOT remove the argparse CLI interface (--dry-run, --positions, --log, --alarms flags must stay)
- In dry-run mode: skip all API calls, log status='dry_run', exit 0
- Keep append_to_jsonl() helper function
- Use sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent)) before imports
- All imports at top of file
- No em-dashes or Unicode in code or strings - ASCII only
acceptanceCriteria: cd businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader && source venv/bin/activate && source ~/.openclaw/.env && python3 scripts/verifier.py --dry-run
userStories.notes:
Rewrote verifier.py to properly verify positions by:
1. Importing get_web3 and get_token_balance from reconcile.py via sys.path.insert
2. Implementing get_nansen_price() to POST to token-screener API

userStories.title: Add API error logging to scanner.py
userStories.description:
Current state: scanner.py exists at businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/scanner.py. It has two cache loaders: _load_screener_cache() around line 45 and _load_netflow_cache() around line 123. Both have except blocks that print an error but do NOT log a structured error to any file. When the Nansen screener returns 0 tokens (network error, 403, empty response) the pipeline silently scans 0 tokens with no alarm. The print statements use [SCREENER] and [NETFLOW] prefixes.

What to build: Add a log_api_error() helper function to scanner.py that appends one JSON line to data/api_error_log.jsonl:
{"ts": ISO timestamp, "source": "screener"|"netflow"|"ohlcv", "error": error string, "tokens_loaded": N}

Call log_api_error() in these locations:
1. In _load_screener_cache() except block: log_api_error('screener', str(e), 0)
2. After _load_screener_cache() completes successfully but len(_screener_cache) == 0: log_api_error('screener', 'empty response - 0 tokens loaded', 0)
3. In _load_netflow_cache() except block: log_api_error('netflow', str(e), 0)
4. After _load_netflow_cache() completes successfully but len(_netflow_cache) == 0: log_api_error('netflow', 'empty response - 0 tokens loaded', 0)

DATA_DIR path: use Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'data' - do NOT use a hardcoded path.

Constraints:
- Only add log_api_error() function and the 4 call sites
- Do NOT change any existing logic, caches, or print statements
- Import Path from pathlib and datetime at top if not already there (they already are)
- No em-dashes or Unicode - ASCII only

userStories.title: Create log_monitor.py with Telegram alerting
userStories.description:
Current state: No log_monitor.py exists. data/run_log.jsonl will exist after US-002 passes. data/api_error_log.jsonl will exist after US-003 passes (if any errors occur). data/exit-monitor.log exists. data/verifier_alarms.jsonl may exist.

Telegram notify pattern (copy from exit_monitor.py): import requests; token = os.environ.get('TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN',''); chat_id = os.environ.get('TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS',''); requests.post(f'https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/sendMessage', json={'chat_id':chat_id,'text':message}, timeout=10)

What to build: New script at businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/log_monitor.py

Script performs 5 checks and sends ONE consolidated Telegram message if any check fails. Silent (no message) if all clean.

Check 1 - Pipeline heartbeat: Read last line of data/run_log.jsonl. Parse ts field. If last run was more than 35 minutes ago: ALERT 'Pipeline heartbeat missed: last run {ts}'. If file does not exist: ALERT 'run_log.jsonl missing - pipeline may not have run yet'

Check 2 - Error scan: Read data/cron.log. Find any line containing 'Traceback', 'Error:', 'CRITICAL', or 'Exception' that appears in the last 150 lines. If found: ALERT 'Errors in cron.log: {first 3 matching lines joined with ||}'

Check 3 - API errors: Read data/api_error_log.jsonl if it exists. Find entries with ts in the last 2 hours. If any found: ALERT 'Nansen API errors ({N} in last 2h): {first error string}'

Check 4 - Verifier alarms: Read data/verifier_alarms.jsonl if it exists. Find entries with ts in the last 2 hours. If any found: ALERT 'Verifier alarm: {alarm text}'

Check 5 - Credit budget: Read data/credit_log.jsonl if it exists. Sum credits_used for today (UTC date prefix match). If sum > 133: ALERT 'Credit budget exceeded: {N} used today (limit 133)'. If sum > 100: WARN (include in message but prefix WARN not ALERT).

At end: if any alerts/warns collected, send single Telegram message:
'[BASE TRADER MONITOR] {timestamp}\n' + each alert on its own line.
If all clean: print '[MONITOR] All checks passed' to stdout only - no Telegram.

Load env from ~/.openclaw/.env at startup using: from pathlib import Path; env_path = Path.home()/'.openclaw'/'.env'; [os.environ.setdefault(k.strip(),v.strip()) for line in env_path.read_text().splitlines() if '=' in line and not line.startswith('#') for k,v in [line.split('=',1)]]

DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'data'

Constraints:
- Single file, no imports from other base-trader scripts
- sys.path manipulation not needed
- Exit 0 always (monitoring script should not break the cron chain)
- No em-dashes or Unicode - ASCII only

userStories.title: Wire verifier into run_pipeline.py and create log_monitor launchd plist
userStories.description:
Current state: run_pipeline.py exists. verifier.py will be fixed (US-001). log_monitor.py will exist (US-004). Two launchd plists exist: com.crestview.base-trader.plist and com.crestview.exit-monitor.plist both in ~/Library/LaunchAgents/.

Part A - Wire verifier into pipeline:
At the END of main() in run_pipeline.py, after write_run_log() call, add:

import subprocess as _subprocess
_venv_python = str(Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'venv' / 'bin' / 'python3')
_verifier = str(Path(__file__).parent / 'verifier.py')
_result = _subprocess.run([_venv_python, _verifier], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=str(Path(__file__).parent.parent))
print(_result.stdout)
if _result.returncode != 0:
    print(f'[PIPELINE] CRITICAL: verifier returned exit {_result.returncode}')
    errors.append(f'verifier failed: exit {_result.returncode}')
